I had a very disappointing experience with Lincoln Park Smiles and want to share it so that prospective patients can make an informed decision.

Before scheduling care, I reviewed the practice's website, which stated that they accept all insurance. Based on that representation, I reasonably believed that my family's routine dental care would be covered similarly to other in-network providers I have used in the past.

Unfortunately, that was not the case.

After receiving what I believed to be routine preventive services for my family, I was surprised to learn that Lincoln Park Smiles was not in-network with my insurance plan. As a result, I ended up paying approximately $1,200 out of pocket for services that I expected would be largely covered.

To be clear, the office did submit claims to my insurance. However, there is a significant difference between accepting insurance and being in-network with an insurance carrier. In my opinion, that distinction was not made sufficiently clear.

I contacted the office, explained my concerns, and requested that they at least waive a portion of the charges. The office declined and instead offered a payment arrangement.

My advice to anyone considering this practice is simple: do not rely solely on statements that a provider "accepts" your insurance. Before receiving treatment, specifically ask whether they are in-network with your exact insurance plan and confirm your expected out-of-pocket costs in writing.

The dental care itself was satisfactory, but the billing experience left me feeling misled and resulted in a much larger financial obligation than I ever anticipated.

If you get anxious about going to the dentist, I would honestly recommend her. I will be going back here for sure.

The entire staff put in the extra effort to make sure I was taken care of and I was seen in a timely fashion. I look forward to continuing my dental care here.
Tasha and Tracy made sure all my financial obligations were thoroughly explained with no hidden costs.

During my appointment on Wednesday, I had one of the best experiences I’ve ever had at a dental office. From the moment I entered the office, the whole team at Aspen Dental made me feel welcomed and seen. Jay was especially helpful during the checkin process offering me water, keeping me updated on my wait time, and making sure everything wast going smoothly. The professionalism, friendliness, and attention to detail from the whole team truly stood out. It’s clear this location has experienced staff, and I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a great dental experience.

I had my wisdom teeth removed at Aspen Dental by Dr. Kabila, and I can honestly say it was one of the best healthcare experiences I’ve had.

Going into the procedure at my age(mid thirties), I was extremely hesitant, anxious, and frankly terrified that something might go wrong. However, Dr. Kabila and her entire dental team immediately put me at ease. From the very beginning, they were patient, understanding, and incredibly reassuring. Every question I had—before, during, and even days after the procedure—was answered thoroughly and without hesitation, which made a huge difference in calming my nerves.

The level of care I received didn’t stop at the procedure itself. The team made sure I was comfortable every step of the way, and their follow-up care showed how much they genuinely care about their patients.

I also want to give a special shoutout to Quin, the hygienist, who did my deep cleaning prior to the extraction. Quin was absolutely fantastic—thorough, gentle, and highly professional. I understand how important a clean, healthy mouth is in preventing infections before a procedure like this, and Quin exceeded all expectations.

Another thing that stood out was how accommodating the office was with scheduling. They worked with my availability and were able to get me in at a time that didn’t leave me waiting weeks or months, which I truly appreciated.

Overall, the entire staff was incredibly friendly, and management demonstrated excellent communication throughout the entire process. I left feeling genuinely cared for and confident in the treatment I received.

As strange as it may sound, I was overjoyed to have my wisdom teeth removed here.

10/10 — I would absolutely recommend Aspen Dental and Dr. Kabila to anyone in need of dental care

I’ve been coming here for about a year and a half, and Blooming Smiles has always been great! Everyone is kind and patient, especially to nervous or anxious clients. I’ve had multiple dentists work with me, and they’ve all met the same bar. Would recommend to anyone looking for a new dentist office to call theirs!

I was a bit nervous going into my appointment because it’s been a while since my last dentist appointment. The whole staff was so welcoming, especially Dr Asami and Lluvia!! Thank you all for a great visit.

Went to this location for 2 years but every time I had an appointment it was a completely different dentist. I saw there was a sign explaining one dentist was on maternity leave, so that's ok, but in 2 years I never saw the same dentist twice. Yet again yesterday I got a text letting me know that my appointment next week would be with a different doctor than the one I originally scheduled with. It's very frustrating seeing a different dentist every time, with a different opinion, despite always scheduling with the same dentist. It does not inspire my confidence and it looks like this office doesn't know how to retain talent and doesn't seem to care that much with the same issue for 2 years. Quality of service is ok here but nothing special. It feels like the people running this place are hyper-optimizing for profit rather than a quality experience.

I looked up another nearby dentist with 2-year old reviews that mention the same doctor as the reviews from last week. Hopefully I can finally get some consistent dental care.
Best dentist experience I’ve ever had! Super professional team, clean office, and very friendly staff that will make you feel welcomed and cared for.
